flags.message: The provisioned document of kind 'brief-in-opposition' (98pp, truncated) concatenates two distinct filings — the Dec 9 2025 cert-stage BIO and the Jul 2 2026 merits response brief (its url field carries both PDFs pipe-separated). Helpful for a merits cell, but the kind label understates the content and a cert-stage consumer of this kind could unknowingly read merits-stage text.
